narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of New Jersey on August 22. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to nearly 6 inches.
ev: NJ Route 72 was closed in Stafford Township due to flooding. Several vehicles were stranded in the flood waters.
Several roads in Surf City were closed due to flooding. Some vehicles were stranded in the flood waters.
Readington Road was closed at Station Road in Branchburg Township due to flooding.
